title: Deeala is good at romance after all

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: Hey! What the fuck did you say to Pilk?!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hey! What the fuck did you say to Pilk?!

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: I saw him this morning. He was talking with a Thera-Pay droid about going back to the Stacks to live with his mom while he reappraises his life.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I saw him this morning. He was talking with a Thera-Pay droid about going back to the Stacks to live with his mom while he reappraises his life.

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: Well... he wasn't cut out for comedy. Obviously. In the long run, you saved him a lot of pain. Though looking at him now... you wouldn't guess it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well... he wasn't cut out for comedy. Obviously. In the long run, you saved him a lot of pain. Though looking at him now... you wouldn't guess it.

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: He's off my back, so I'm left in peace. For now. So I owe you. Thank you. I mean it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: He's off my back, so I'm left in peace. For now. So I owe you. Thank you. I mean it.

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: Look, I like you. I do. I don't know if we're gonna hook up, but I'm not... against the idea.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Look, I like you. I do. I don't know if we're gonna hook up, but I'm not... against the idea.

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: Haha! Fuck all that. I just want to get you drunk, rip your ugly clothes off and tie you to my bed posts for the weekend.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Haha! Fuck all that. I just want to get you drunk, rip your ugly clothes off and tie you to my bed posts for the weekend.

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: Well, it will need to be a bedposts in a new apartment, when I'm away from Pilk Dane, and we're BOTH out of this damn LUZ.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, it will need to be a bedposts in a new apartment, when I'm away from Pilk Dane, and we're BOTH out of this damn LUZ.

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: Alright, it's a deal. Now let's pick this up later. I'm late for my shift, again, and you look like you've got some work to do.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Alright, it's a deal. Now let's pick this up later. I'm late for my shift, again, and you look like you've got some work to do.

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: Well go take care of your business. When it's all over, and we're both ready to get out of here... I'll be waiting for you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well go take care of your business. When it's all over, and we're both ready to get out of here... I'll be waiting for you.

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: He's still an asshole, but you bought me some time. He's not even hassling me for rent this month. Yet. So I can save a little and move out soon.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: He's still an asshole, but you bought me some time. He's not even hassling me for rent this month. Yet. So I can save a little and move out soon.

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: But first I need out of my old apartment. And I need this damn LUZ to be over before I start thinking about...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: But first I need out of my old apartment. And I need this damn LUZ to be over before I start thinking about...

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: Romance. Coffee and walks in the park. Holding hands and writing each other poems.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Romance. Coffee and walks in the park. Holding hands and writing each other poems.

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: So gimme a little time, ok? And for our first date, I'll take you to Molyphonic. And we'll go from there.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So gimme a little time, ok? And for our first date, I'll take you to Molyphonic. And we'll go from there.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I made a joke.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I made a joke.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I don't really know.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't really know.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I made ONE joke.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I made ONE joke.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I barely even spoke with him.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I barely even spoke with him.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I barely even spoke with him.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I barely even spoke with him.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What will happen to you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What will happen to you?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You're welcome.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're welcome.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What about... us?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What about... us?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: About?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: About?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Wha... what?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Wha... what?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sure thing Deeala.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sure thing Deeala.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I do.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I do.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: See you, Deeala.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: See you, Deeala.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'll shop for a new outfit.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'll shop for a new outfit.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'll shop for a new outfit.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'll shop for a new outfit.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So about that date...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So about that date...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That sounds pretty good actually.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That sounds pretty good actually.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Us?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Us?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: For now. What about the future?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: For now. What about the future?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: For now. What about the future?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: For now. What about the future?
